description: Report of discovered routes, group routes and their relationships. Decodes to the same model as SynchronizationRequest.

pluginRouteId.description: The external ID of the route

type.description: The type of the route that has been discovered

items.description: A reference to a route interface
items.title: RouteInterfaceRef

items.description: A provider-reported group route (for example a vacuum map or room, a lighting room or a speaker group) as carried by discovery. It is shared by the route-discovery report message and `SynchronizationRequest.groupRoutes` so both decode to the same model.

pluginRouteId.description: Plugin-owned stable identifier of the group route. Must be unique across routes and group routes within one plugin and auth link.

name.description: The name of the associated group route

messages.description: Supported inbound message subset for the declared interface version. Omission or null retains the interface's full message contract; a supplied array must be nonempty and contain distinct canonical names for implemented messages.

value.description: the value of the attribute, this is an opaque resource object, so it can be any type of struct.

attributes.description: Supported attribute subset. An omitted or empty list retains catalog-default behavior.

memberPluginRouteIds.description: List of plugin route IDs that are members of this group route

pluginCustomMetadata.description: Private plugin metadata (native map, segment or cloud room addressing) returned to the plugin on dispatch; never exposed as application data.

items.title: GroupRoute

items.description: A provider-reported relationship between routes and group routes. Identity is `externalId` within the reporting plugin and auth link; resubmitting the same `externalId` updates the relationship. Omission from a later synchronization is not a deletion instruction.

externalId.description: Plugin-owned stable identifier of the relationship.

type.description: Typed relationship between provider routes and group routes. `IS_PART_OF`: a group route is contained in a parent group route (spatial hierarchy, acyclic). `CAN_CONTROL`: an endpoint route can act on a group route with the listed interface messages; it never grants authorization. `LOCATED_IN`: an endpoint route is currently observed inside a group route; it is an observation, not membership.

source.description: One end of a discovered relationship, addressed by plugin-owned identity within the reporting plugin and auth link. Exactly one of `pluginRouteId` (a route) or `groupPluginRouteId` (a group route) must be set.

pluginRouteId.description: The plugin route ID of a route reported in the same or an earlier synchronization.

groupPluginRouteId.description: The plugin route ID of a group route reported in the same or an earlier synchronization.

source.title: PluginDiscoveryRelationshipVertex

interfaces.description: Optional interface applicability; used by `CAN_CONTROL` to declare which messages the source supports on the target.

items.description: Capability-interface applicability of a relationship, for example the robotic-vacuum-cleaner messages a `CAN_CONTROL` edge supports on a room.

messages.description: Message names of the interface the relationship applies to. Omitted means every message of the interface.

items.title: RelationshipInterface
